notes.title: Shogun Showdown review: an exceptional roguelike that hits different
notes.content:
Like a samurai poised patiently for an opening in their opponent’s defences, Shogun Showdown understands that focus and finesse are the means to delivering an impactful blow. This rare roguelike distils the genre down to its purest components, all in favour of amplifying its dizzying combat that plays gracefully with the concepts of positioning and patience. Highly refined, stylish and complex, Shogun Showdown is a delight.

Read more

[expand type=details expanded=false][h3]New content[/h3]
Final ascension: Day 7
New elite type
New enemy
???
New Hero: The Chain Master.
New location: Ieyasu's garden + new boss (Ieyasu the Patient)

[list][*] Rogue Retail
[*] Seiryu's Scale
[*] Fenghuangs's Feather

[*] Odd Curse[/list]
New quests:

[*] Nagiboku
[*] Sharp Turn (replaces Turn Around)

[*] Thorns

Signature Move buff (7CD -> 5CD)

Strategist ultimate stamp is now 800 turns instead of 900
Dancer shop buff: Two-way Move and Damaging Move skills no longer add +1CD to your special move
Warrior's gamble in shops: 5$ instead of 10$
Can use Kami Brew out of combat if you have the Shield Retention skill

[h3]Polish / visuals[/h3]
Animated title screen
Colored icons for shops in map
In Shops, auto-hide long shrine descriptions when you highlight held skills (so that the skills are no longer hoplessly hidden beghind the shrine description)

Reworked combo VFX
Polished up the camp environment
New graphics for Moonlit Port Shop
Rearranged order of tiles in Camp Archive
Map: gamepad/keyborard-only button prompt for location selection
Reworked Shadow Kama attack animation
Reworked Tanageshima attack animation
Reworked Crossbow attack animation
Reworked Arrow attack animation
Reworked Blade of Patience attack animation
Reworked Swirl attack animation
Reworked Katana attack animation
Polished quests notification UI

notes.title: Gamepad Update is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm glad to announce that the first goal of our roadmap is there!

[h3]GAMEPAD UPDATE IS OUT NOW![/h3]

This does mean that you can play the game with your favorite controller! As some of you might have seen already, we've been able to get the "Steamdeck Verified" check so that's also great news for Steamdeck people!

Some of you might not be aware though, there is a little bad news. We wanted to get the key/button binding in this update too, however we had some difficulties having it ready and tested yet. We'd rather publish the gamepad update without it since a lot of people were waiting for it.

Key and buttons remapping is still in the pipe and is definitely happening, you just have to be a bit more patient, and we'll give you more news as we'll have some to share!
For now you'd have to use the default layout, don't hesitate to play the tutorial again to get familiar with it!

Along with bug fixing, here's the major changes for the 0.6 version :
[list]
[*] Gamepad support.
[*] Steam Deck compatibility.
[*] New tile enchantment: Perfect Strike.
[*] Increased max skull limit to 9999.
[/list]
We'll be releasing more minor updates with improvements on the input system (e.g. key rebinding), so let us know your thoughts!
Stay tuned for the next major update, which will be all about new content!

Cheers,

~Mirko and Goblinz team

notes.title: Shogun Showdown's Cloud update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We  had issues with the Steam Cloud. Long story short, it only worked between the same OS, and, only the metaprogression was saved. But if you stopped mid-run to continue on another computer, you'd have to start your run over again

[b]From now on, you should be able to keep your save and ongoing run saved to the cloud, no matter which OS you use![/b]

The main use-case of this would be with the Steamdeck, being able to save and quit on PC then continue your run on Steamdeck.

Talking about Steamdeck, someone in the team made an unofficial gamepad layout, so you've got a layout to play with before the official gamepad support comes.

Have a fantastic week!
